{{Top|leg}}
The '''Arized''' was a group that included brilliant [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], who designed the [[Surfeik cruiser]]s. After the [[Vagaari Empire]] [[Extermination of the Arized homeworld|exterminated]] the [[Arized homeworld]], the [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] claimed the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruisers]] as their own and eventually incorporated them into their [[Vagaari slaver fleet|fleet]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Arized were introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
